question.prompt:
The front view of a rectangular prism is a rectangle of length 5 cm and height 3 cm. Its left view is a rectangle of width 2 cm and height 3 cm. Find the surface area of the rectangular prism. (Unit: cm²)

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_283_q5_question_en.svg)

solutions.explanation: The two views show that the rectangular prism has length 5, width 2, and height 3. Its surface area is \(2\times(5\times3+2\times3+5\times2)=2\times31=62\).
solutions.title: Dimensions and paired face areas
